name: chain a compression function over padded blocks from a fixed start
mechanism: pad the message to whole blocks with its length appended; start from a fixed state and, for each block, replace the state by a fixed one-way compression of (state, block); the final state is the digest, so a collision in the compression function is a collision in the whole
